opennyai_summary.decision:
Hence, I answer Issue No.3 accordingly and pass the following:
 ORDER
Petitions filed under Section 166 of IMV Act by Manjunath and Praveen Gowda, which are registered as M.V.C.No.4076/2024 and MVC No.4077/2024 are partly allowed.
In M.V.C.No.4076/2024, the respondents shall either jointly or severally pay Rs.25,69,168/-
(Rupees Twenty five lakhs sixty nine thousand one hundred and sixty eight only) with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. on Rs.12,13,568/- (Rupees Twelve lakhs thirteen thousand five hundred and sixty eight only) from 21.04.2025 to petitioner - Manjunath towards compensation.
(Rs.13,05,600/-
awarded under the C/w. MVC No.4077/2024 head of loss of future income and Rs.50,000/-
awarded under head of purchase of artificial limb does not carry interest).
In M.V.C.No.4077/2024, the respondents shall either jointly or severally pay Rs.1,07,720/- (Rupees One lakh Seven thousand Seven hundred and twenty only) with current and future interest at the rate of 6% p.a., to petitioner-Praveen Gowda towards compensation.
In both the cases, respondent No.2 being the insurer of Car bearing No.KA-08-M-5570 shall deposit the compensation within 3 months from today.
In MVC No.4076/2024, after deposit of the compensation amount, 50% compensation amount and interest may be released to the petitioner by crediting the same to his bank account directly.
In MVC No.4076/2024, surplus compensation and interest shall be deposited in any bank in the name of the petitioner for a period of 5 years without permitting to create any encumbrances reserving liberty to withdraw periodical interest once in three months in accordance with law.
C/w. MVC No.4077/2024 In MVC No.4077/2024, after deposit, entire compensation amount and interest may be released to the petitioner-Praveen Gowda by crediting the same to his bank account directly.
Advocate's fee is fixed at Rs.1,000/- in each case.
Draw Awards accordingly.
